Thomas, saw Kinective acquired OrboGraph and shipped SignPlus Gateway, your seventh expansion.

Stacking acquisitions like that usually means more mid-market institutions in play than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Kinective off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Thomas, quick follow-up for Kinective.

A broader platform usually pushes the mid-market number up faster than headcount can cover. Most sales leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your mid-market segment needs, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how Kinective's reply rate likely compares to similar fintech software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
